summary: Added scripts/systemd/moltbot-gateway-restart-trigger.path and scripts/systemd/moltbot-gateway-restart-trigger.service. The path unit watches .req restart files in both ~/.moltbot and ~/.clawdbot request directories; the oneshot service restarts moltbot-gateway-dev.service and deletes queued .req files only after successful restart. Verified file lifecycle behavior with a local shell simulation (success deletes files, failure leaves files).
